Write the whole-module specification

Read input: rtlpp_02409_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_02409(
    input           clk,
    input           reset,
    input [8:0]     vl,    
    input [1:0]     vcsr_quant,    
    input           I_clear,    
    input [2:0]     I_id,    
    output          ALU_mon,
    output          stall,
    output          DONE,
    input [31:0]    proc_addr,
    input [31:0]    proc_din,
    output [31:0]   proc_dout,
    input           proc_we,
    output [4:0]    XRF_ADDR,
    output [31:0]   XRF_DATAWR,
    output          XRF_WE,
    input           I_start,
    input [4:0]     I_vs1,
    input [4:0]     I_vs2,
    input [4:0]     I_vd,
    input [31:0]    I_RS1,
    input [31:0]    I_RS2,
    input [4:0]     I_uimm5,
    input [7:0]     I_funct,
    input [1:0]     I_permute,
    input           I_mask_en,
    input [1:0]     I_ALUSrc,
    input           I_dmr,
    input           I_dmw,
    input           I_reg_we,
    input           I_mem_reg,
    input           I_Xout,
    input [1:0]     I_mode_lsu
);

// Internal signals
reg [31:0] proc_dout_reg;
reg [4:0]  XRF_ADDR_reg;
reg [31:0] XRF_DATAWR_reg;
reg        XRF_WE_reg;
reg        ALU_mon_reg;
reg        stall_reg;
reg        DONE_reg;

// Logic implementation
always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        proc_dout_reg <= 32'b0;
        XRF_ADDR_reg  <= 5'b0;
        XRF_DATAWR_reg<= 32'b0;
        XRF_WE_reg    <= 1'b0;
        ALU_mon_reg   <= 1'b0;
        stall_reg     <= 1'b0;
        DONE_reg      <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        if (proc_we) begin
            proc_dout_reg <= proc_din;
        end else begin
            proc_dout_reg <= proc_dout_reg;
        end

        if (I_start) begin
            XRF_ADDR_reg <= I_vs1;
            XRF_DATAWR_reg <= I_RS1;
            XRF_WE_reg <= I_reg_we;
        end else begin
            XRF_ADDR_reg <= 5'b0;
            XRF_DATAWR_reg <= 32'b0;
            XRF_WE_reg <= 1'b0;
        end

        // Custom logic for ALU, stall, and DONE signals based on the inputs and internal operations
        ALU_mon_reg <= I_ALUSrc[0]; // Example logic
        stall_reg <= I_mask_en; // Example logic
        DONE_reg <= I_clear; // Example logic

    end
end

assign proc_dout = proc_dout_reg;
assign XRF_ADDR = XRF_ADDR_reg;
assign XRF_DATAWR = XRF_DATAWR_reg;
assign XRF_WE = XRF_WE_reg;
assign ALU_mon = ALU_mon_reg;
assign stall = stall_reg;
assign DONE = DONE_reg;

endmodule
